exposure: multidisciplinary clinic (MDC) care model for youth with Type 2 Diabetes
outcome: completion rates of annual screening labs
cohort: The study participants were 227 youth with Type 2 Diabetes (mean age 17.6 years, mean BMI 40.9kg/m2, 64% female, 50% Black or African American, 65% public insurance) seen in the T2D MDC clinic at Cincinnati Children's Hospital.
finding: The majority of patients in the multidisciplinary clinic received diabetes and nutrition education and completed annual screening labs, though exercise counseling and some sub-specialty care access remained below 60%.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from charts for the period 1/2020 to 12/2021.
